page: Microsoft Azure D32pds_v7 is an ARM-based general purpose virtual machine instance running on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system provides 32 dedicated vCPUs built on the arm64 architecture, paired with 128.0 GB of memory. This configuration maintains a standard general-purpose ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Accelerators such as GPUs are not present in this configuration, focusing resources strictly on central processing and memory throughput.

A significant hardware characteristic of the D32pds_v7 is its integrated local storage subsystem, which features 1888 GB of direct-attached NVMe SSD capacity alongside support for Azure Premium Storage. The local NVMe disk offers high IOPS and low latency for temporary data pools, swap space, or high-speed caching layers. Network connectivity does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring standard Azure virtual network routing or public IP assignment for external communication.

From an efficiency standpoint, the ARM-based compute architecture provides a cost-effective alternative to x86 implementations by maximizing per-core performance density and power efficiency across high-concurrency environments. A key architectural consideration is the lack of x86 vector extensions such as AVX-512 or AMX, which requires software stacks to be natively compiled or compatible with 64-bit ARM instruction sets.

The D32pds_v7 is suited for balanced scale-out enterprise workloads. Primary deployment scenarios include relational and NoSQL databases benefiting from local NVMe cache, large-scale web application serving, continuous integration and build pipelines, and data transformation jobs that demand a steady balance of 32 dedicated ARM cores and substantial memory capacity.
description: Microsoft Azure D32pds_v7 is a general purpose virtual machine featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs built on the 64-bit ARM architecture and 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB per core ratio. The instance includes 1888 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage and supports Azure Premium Storage for external disk volumes. It operates without hardware GPU accelerators or included complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Built on Microsoft Hyper-V, the D32pds_v7 offers an efficient, dense computing profile for workloads compiled for ARM64 environments. The combination of dedicated core execution, ample memory capacity, and high-speed temporary NVMe storage positions this instance well for relational database caching, web server clusters, enterprise application backends, and containerized microservices requiring consistent performance and low I/O latency.
